ships.name: Strike Cruiser
ships.description: The Union's standoff bombardment ship, built around a deep torpedo magazine. Use it to open battles and break planetary defenses; keep it out of close-range brawls.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser II
ships.description: A heavier Keldon refit with a larger warhead load and stiffer shields. Still a first-strike platform, now a lethal one.

ships.name: Colony Ship
ships.description: Cardassian settler ship carrying colonists, prefabricated habitats and soil processors. Unarmed and slow: escort it to an unclaimed system and it founds a colony.

ships.name: Colony Ship II
ships.description: The late-model Ranol, better protected and fitted with modern terraforming kits. Same mission, better odds of arriving.

ships.name: Battleship
ships.description: The symbol of Cardassian military power, armored like a fortress and armed nearly as well. As a command ship it steadies the task force it leads.

ships.name: Battleship II
ships.description: The Galor refit adds heavy phaser banks and still more protection. Central Command reserves it for its most trusted guls.

ships.name: Outpost
ships.description: A small frontier station built on site by a transport crew. It extends fleet supply range, watches the surrounding sectors and can fend off light raiders.

ships.name: Outpost II
ships.description: An upgraded frontier station with more guns, thicker shields and longer sensor reach. It can hold a sector against anything short of a determined assault.

ships.name: Destroyer
ships.description: A fast Cardassian patrol ship with guns out of proportion to its armor. Ideal for catching scouts, transports and colony ships that stray across the border.

ships.name: Destroyer II
ships.description: Upgraded targeting and a wider weapons fit let this Netel raid weakly held systems as well as patrol.

ships.name: Scout
ships.description: A cheap, far-ranging Cardassian scout with good sensors and token weapons. Send it ahead to chart systems and spot enemy fleets.

ships.name: Scout II
ships.description: A faster, sturdier Nerok with the best sensors in the Union fleet. Good for shadowing enemy fleets, not for fighting them.

ships.name: Starbase
ships.description: A fortress station built around an existing outpost, with repair docks, deep supply stores and heavy batteries. It anchors a key sector and every fleet operating from it.

ships.name: Starbase II
ships.description: A late-model starbase that is, in practical terms, a fleet that cannot move. Attack it with everything or not at all.

ships.name: Troop Transport
ships.description: Cardassian troop carrier for ground invasions, whose hull also becomes the core of new outposts and starbases. Unarmed; never send it in alone.

ships.name: Troop Transport II
ships.description: More troop berths, heavier armor and stronger shields for landings under fire.

ships.name: Cruiser
ships.description: A Cardassian line cruiser built to kill ships and installations. Its reinforced frame fights on after its shields collapse.

ships.name: Cruiser II
ships.description: A Neterok rebuilt with current-generation weapons and hull plating: durable and hard-hitting.

ships.name: Heavy Cruiser
ships.description: A heavy assault cruiser for cracking fortified systems. Slow, short-ranged and very hard to kill.

ships.name: Heavy Cruiser II
ships.description: The Telok refit crams in yet more firepower. Few ships short of a dreadnought want to trade blows with it.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser
ships.description: A Nebula-class hull fitted with a large torpedo pod. Deadliest early in a fight, and well suited to softening up a planet before an invasion.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser II
ships.description: Extra launchers and improved torpedo guidance let this Nebula saturate a target before the enemy closes.

ships.name: Colony Ship
ships.description: Federation colony transport carrying settlers and everything a new human world needs. Unarmed; escort it through contested space.

ships.name: Colony Ship II
ships.description: A modernized Edward with stronger shields and up-to-date terraforming equipment.

ships.name: Command Cruiser
ships.description: Starfleet's great multi-mission ship, at home on a survey or in a fleet action. Its command facilities coordinate every ship in its task force.

ships.name: Command Cruiser II
ships.description: A service-life refit of the Galaxy class: more weapons, stronger shields and the same superb command suite.

ships.name: Dreadnought
ships.description: The newest ship of the line from Utopia Planitia, pairing long phaser strips and quantum launchers with formidable shields. It also leads the fleet around it.

ships.name: Dreadnought II
ships.description: The Sovereign refit, Starfleet's most heavily armed and best-shielded ship. The last word in Federation design.

ships.name: Outpost
ships.description: A small frontier station built on site by a transport crew. It extends fleet supply range, watches the surrounding sectors and can fend off light raiders.

ships.name: Outpost II
ships.description: An upgraded frontier station with more guns, thicker shields and longer sensor reach. It can hold a sector against anything short of a determined assault.

ships.name: Destroyer
ships.description: An old but trusted Starfleet escort, cheap to build and dependable on frontier patrol against raiders.

ships.name: Destroyer II
ships.description: Bigger engines and upgraded arrays turn the Miranda into a quick-reaction escort.

ships.name: Heavy Destroyer
ships.description: A four-nacelle escort that is heavier and faster than it looks. Raiders expecting an easy kill regret it.

ships.name: Heavy Destroyer II
ships.description: A new drive and shield-penetrating weapon refinements keep this veteran design competitive.

ships.name: Heavy Escort
ships.description: A compact, overpowered warship built for one purpose: combat. Fast, heavily armed and able to beat ships twice its size.

ships.name: Science Vessel
ships.description: A small Starfleet research ship with long range and excellent sensors. Use it to explore; keep it away from fights.

ships.name: Science Vessel II
ships.description: A tougher Oberth with longer sensor reach and enough weapons to survive a bad first contact.

ships.name: Starbase
ships.description: A fortress station built around an existing outpost, with repair docks, deep supply stores and heavy batteries. It anchors a key sector and every fleet operating from it.

ships.name: Starbase II
ships.description: A late-model starbase that is, in practical terms, a fleet that cannot move. Attack it with everything or not at all.

ships.name: Troop Transport
ships.description: Starfleet troop and construction transport, used to invade worlds and to build outposts. Unarmed and dependent on escorts.

ships.name: Troop Transport II
ships.description: More capacity and heavier shields, so more troops or builders arrive intact.

ships.name: Heavy Cruiser
ships.description: A dedicated battleship spun off from the Galaxy design, with a third nacelle and a hull crammed with weapons. It can soak up damage that would gut a lighter ship.

ships.name: Heavy Cruiser II
ships.description: The refit tri-nacelle battleship adds heavier guns while keeping pace with escorts.

ships.name: Light Cruiser
ships.description: A sturdy, well-armed Starfleet cruiser for long patrols in dangerous space. Often the first real warship a growing Federation fields.

ships.name: Light Cruiser II
ships.description: The Ambassador refit mounts modern arrays and shields, a clear warning to aggressive neighbors.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser
ships.description: A Ferengi torpedo boat that settles disputes at long range, before the competition can close. Badly outgunned up close.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser II
ships.description: Reinforced shields and a bigger magazine make the refit Ooron a formidable standoff and bombardment ship.

ships.name: Colony Ship
ships.description: Ferengi colony transport that opens new worlds to settlement, and to business. Unarmed and clumsy; escort it.

ships.name: Colony Ship II
ships.description: Better shields and modern terraforming gear, so the new colony turns a profit sooner.

ships.name: Marauder
ships.description: The Alliance flagship, a reward for DaiMons with deep pockets and the right friends. Heavy weapons persuade rivals to negotiate; heavy shields guarantee a way out.

ships.name: Marauder II
ships.description: Faster, tougher and carrying upgraded torpedoes: the most expensive and most persuasive ship in the Alliance.

ships.name: Outpost
ships.description: A small frontier station built on site by a transport crew. It extends fleet supply range, watches the surrounding sectors and can fend off light raiders.

ships.name: Outpost II
ships.description: An upgraded frontier station with more guns, thicker shields and longer sensor reach. It can hold a sector against anything short of a determined assault.

ships.name: Light Raider
ships.description: A cheap, fast hit-and-run raider that makes raiding pay. Easily written off when a raid goes wrong.

ships.name: Light Raider II
ships.description: Uprated engines let this Ngort run down the fastest freighters, and its guns enforce Alliance impound law.

ships.name: Raider
ships.description: A fast, well-protected Alliance raider that polices trade lanes and seizes suspect cargo. Surprisingly well armed.

ships.name: Raider II
ships.description: Uprated guns and engines make this refit the quickest raider in the quadrant.

ships.name: Explorer
ships.description: A small Ferengi scout that hunts for opportunities and watches competitors. Its reports steer where the Alliance invests.

ships.name: Explorer II
ships.description: A long-range Bronta with a bigger drive and better protection, for prospecting at the edge of Ferengi space.

ships.name: Starbase
ships.description: A fortress station built around an existing outpost, with repair docks, deep supply stores and heavy batteries. It anchors a key sector and every fleet operating from it.

ships.name: Starbase II
ships.description: A late-model starbase that is, in practical terms, a fleet that cannot move. Attack it with everything or not at all.

ships.name: Troop Transport
ships.description: Ferengi troop carrier for hostile takeovers of the planetary kind, and a crew ferry for outpost construction. Unarmed.

ships.name: Troop Transport II
ships.description: More troops, bigger engines and better shields: an improvement on every line of the ledger.

ships.name: War Cruiser
ships.description: A Ferengi line cruiser that guards Alliance holdings. Would-be corporate raiders meet it first.

ships.name: War Cruiser II
ships.description: A long-overdue refit: heavy torpedoes, better shields, quicker engines.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser
ships.description: A coveted Klingon command that opens every battle with a torrent of torpedoes. Nothing of its tonnage carries more firepower.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser II
ships.description: More torpedoes and more disruptors. Its first volley often decides the fight.

ships.name: Armed Colony Ship
ships.description: A Klingon colony ship that carries light guns beside its settlers. It can see off a raider, but not a warship.

ships.name: Armed Colony Ship II
ships.description: A refit with modern terraforming kits and heavier guns; the Empire settles worlds the way it takes them.

ships.name: Attack Cruiser
ships.description: The Klingon fleet's favorite command: a cruiser carrying more and heavier weapons than almost any rival. It leads the charge.

ships.name: Attack Cruiser II
ships.description: An even deadlier Vor'cha, tougher all round and with longer-reaching guns.

ships.name: Outpost
ships.description: A small frontier station built on site by a transport crew. It extends fleet supply range, watches the surrounding sectors and can fend off light raiders.

ships.name: Outpost II
ships.description: An upgraded frontier station with more guns, thicker shields and longer sensor reach. It can hold a sector against anything short of a determined assault.

ships.name: Destroyer
ships.description: A fast Klingon hunter with heavy guns for its size, able to operate far from support.

ships.name: Destroyer II
ships.description: The refit May'Duj adds armor, shields and a far heavier gun deck. Escorts are no longer a worry.

ships.name: Scout
ships.description: The Klingon fleet's scout and raider, cloaked and quick. It finds the enemy first and picks off their support ships.

ships.name: Scout II
ships.description: The refit B'rel trades some patience for real teeth; it now hunts as well as watches.

ships.name: Starbase
ships.description: A fortress station built around an existing outpost, with repair docks, deep supply stores and heavy batteries. It anchors a key sector and every fleet operating from it.

ships.name: Starbase II
ships.description: A late-model starbase that is, in practical terms, a fleet that cannot move. Attack it with everything or not at all.

ships.name: Assault Transport
ships.description: A Klingon assault transport with light weapons, so the warriors aboard can shoot back on the way in. It still needs escorts.

ships.name: Assault Transport II
ships.description: Larger troop holds and stronger weapons and shields, so it lands more warriors.

ships.name: Battle Cruiser
ships.description: Klingon crews love this veteran design, rebuilt with modern armor and disruptors. It still out-slugs most cruisers.

ships.name: Battle Cruiser II
ships.description: The refit K't'inga carries modern shields and disruptors. With an aggressive captain it wins fights it has no business winning.

ships.name: Heavy Cruiser
ships.description: Klingon shipwrights took the Bird of Prey's lines and built a battle cruiser around them. It is all weapons and wings.

ships.name: Heavy Cruiser II
ships.description: The ultimate refit of the Bird of Prey battle cruiser, with more engine and more gun than any before it.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser
ships.description: A Romulan torpedo ship built around the cloak: decloak, empty the launchers, exploit the confusion.

ships.name: Strike Cruiser II
ships.description: More launchers, more disruptors and improved warheads make its opening strike devastating.

ships.name: Colony Ship
ships.description: Romulan colony ship carrying settlers and equipment for new worlds. Unarmed; protect it in contested space.

ships.name: Colony Ship II
ships.description: Stronger shields, nimbler handling and improved terraforming equipment.

ships.name: Warbird
ships.description: The great warbird at the heart of every Romulan task force. Its volleys can erase an unprepared fleet.

ships.name: Warbird II
ships.description: The refit warbird is the strongest ship the Romulan Empire has ever launched. Few enemies can face one alone.

ships.name: Outpost
ships.description: A small frontier station built on site by a transport crew. It extends fleet supply range, watches the surrounding sectors and can fend off light raiders.

ships.name: Outpost II
ships.description: An upgraded frontier station with more guns, thicker shields and longer sensor reach. It can hold a sector against anything short of a determined assault.

ships.name: Destroyer
ships.description: A stealthy Romulan hunter that intercepts trespassers and preys on supply lines.

ships.name: Destroyer II
ships.description: Better weapons and shields and, above all, much stronger engines make it a relentless pursuer.

ships.name: Scout
ships.description: A long-range Romulan explorer with just enough firepower to bully transports. Anything bigger sends it running.

ships.name: Scout II
ships.description: Stronger engines to outrun larger ships, and shields that hold longer when it cannot.

ships.name: Starbase
ships.description: A fortress station built around an existing outpost, with repair docks, deep supply stores and heavy batteries. It anchors a key sector and every fleet operating from it.

ships.name: Starbase II
ships.description: A late-model starbase that is, in practical terms, a fleet that cannot move. Attack it with everything or not at all.

ships.name: Troop Transport
ships.description: Romulan troop and construction transport for invasions and outpost work. Unarmed.

ships.name: Troop Transport II
ships.description: An uprated R'daran whose bigger reactor drives both faster engines and stronger shields.

ships.name: Battle Cruiser
ships.description: A Romulan battle cruiser with top-grade shields and heavy weapons, able to meet any cruiser head-on.

ships.name: Battle Cruiser II
ships.description: One of the strongest Romulan warships, with massive engines that answer threats quickly.

ships.name: Cruiser
ships.description: A cloaked ambusher tasked with making sure intruders deep in Romulan space never report home.

ships.name: Cruiser II
ships.description: A full weapons swap makes the refit R'derex the most dreaded ambusher in the fleet.

ships.name: Acamarian Raider
ships.description: A fast, mid-sized raider flown by the Acamarian clans. Nimble and well armed for its size, it is the kind of ship that made the Gatherers notorious.

ships.name: Bajoran fighter
ships.description: A small, agile Bajoran attack craft, built by a people who learned to fight a far larger enemy. Cheap to field and quick to strike.

ships.name: Ktarian Raider
ships.description: A light Ktarian raider that relies on cunning rather than power. It favors quick strikes over sustained combat.

ships.name: Pakled Transport
ships.description: A cobbled-together Pakled hull stuffed with weapons found, traded or borrowed. It is stronger than it looks, and it looks strong.

ships.name: Sheliak Raider
ships.description: A Sheliak patrol raider that enforces treaty boundaries with precision and little patience. Tougher than most minor-race craft.

ships.name: Talarian Warship
ships.description: A heavily armed Talarian warship with strong shields and a reinforced hull. Talarian commanders favor direct assaults.

ships.name: Tamarian Defender
ships.description: A sturdy, well-armored Tamarian cruiser. Its crew speaks in metaphor; its weapons need no translation.

ships.name: Trill Warship
ships.description: A balanced Trill cruiser built to defend Trill space. Its commanders may bring several lifetimes of experience to the bridge.

ships.name: Vulcan ship
ships.description: A Vulcan research cruiser, logically equipped for both science and self-defense. It carries more firepower than its peaceful mission suggests.

ships.name: Yridian Scout
ships.description: A fast Yridian courier and scout, built to carry information to whoever pays best.

ships.name: Borg Cube
ships.description: A cybernetic vessel of overwhelming power that repairs itself and adapts to its attackers. No single fleet should expect to survive contact.

ships.name: Gaseous Lifeform
ships.description: A sentient cloud of ionized gas that engulfs ships and tears at their shields. It cannot be reasoned with and is hard to disperse.

ships.name: Dreadnought
ships.description: A massive Chodak warship, heavily shielded and armed, that treats any vessel in its path as a target.

ships.name: Unknown Lifeform
ships.description: A vast crystalline lifeform that strips ships and worlds of organic life. Its lattice shrugs off conventional fire.

ships.name: Combat Drone
ships.description: An autonomous weapons drone that outlived its makers and still hunts anything it does not recognize.

ships.name: Alien Entity
ships.description: A godlike presence watching over the Edo homeworld. Its power is effectively unlimited; the wise simply leave.

ships.name: Sentient Starship
ships.description: A living starship, alone and searching the void. It does not attack, but its immense bulk withstands almost any assault.

ships.name: Husnock vessel
ships.description: A warship of the vanished Husnock, still roaming the dark. Heavily shielded and quick to open fire.

ships.name: Orbital Battery
ships.description: A fixed weapons platform guarding a system from orbit. It cannot move, but it defends its world with steady fire.

ships.name: Tarellian vessel
ships.description: A plague ship of Tarellian refugees, drifting from world to world. Shunned everywhere, it fights when cornered.
